calibration_method: Selected strictly on validation split to prevent test data leakage, then frozen for untouched test evaluation.
justification: In surveillance and physical security systems, Cost(Missed Fight / False Negative) >> Cost(False Alarm / False Positive). Lowering the operational threshold from 0.50 to 0.40 elevates Violence Recall from 82.26% to 85.48% (rescuing missed altercations like fi085.mp4) while maintaining strong precision (86.89%) and achieving the system's global peak F1-score of 86.18%.
deployment_rule: if prob_violence >= 0.40: TRIGGER_SECURITY_ALERT(level='HIGH', notify='SECURITY_GUARD_APP') else: SYSTEM_NORMAL_STATE
